teaser.en: It looks like the garden egg's wild twin, but its round yellow fruits are not eaten.
teaser.sw: Unafanana na pacha wa porini wa ngogwe, lakini matunda yake ya mviringo ya manjano hayaliwi.
teaser.dg: Unaonekana dza patsa wa weruni wa *tungudza*, ela matundage ga mviringo ga rangi ya mandano tagariwa.

summary.en: *Mtungudza koma* is the Sodom apple, a prickly, grey-felted shrub with purple flowers and round yellow fruits. It is the wild, inedible relative of the cultivated garden egg, and its roots and leaves are used for malaria.
summary.sw: *Mtungudza koma* ni kichaka kinachoitwa kwa Kiingereza *Sodom apple*, chenye miiba midogo na manyoya laini ya kijivu, maua ya zambarau na matunda ya mviringo ya manjano. Ni jamaa wa porini asiyelika wa ngogwe inayolimwa, na mizizi na majani yake hutumika kwa malaria.
summary.dg: *Mtungudza koma* (kpwa Chingereza *Sodom apple*) ni chitsaka chenye miya, chenye laika za rangi ya ivu, maruwa ga zambarau na matunda ga mviringo ga rangi ya mandano. Ni ndugu wa weruni wa *tungudza* inayophandwa, ambaye matundage tagariwa, na mizi na makodza nkuhumirwa kpwa homa (malaria).

about.en: *Mtungudza koma* is a shrub covered in soft grey felt and armed with sharp prickles on the stems and leaves. Its flowers are purple with a yellow centre, the same shape as tomato and eggplant flowers, to which it is related. The fruits are round, about the size of a marble or larger, and turn yellow when ripe.
about.sw: *Mtungudza koma* ni kichaka kilichofunikwa na manyoya laini ya kijivu na chenye miiba mikali kwenye mashina na majani. Maua yake ni ya zambarau yenye kiini cha manjano, yenye umbo sawa na maua ya nyanya na biringani, ambazo ni jamaa zake. Matunda ni ya mviringo, takriban ukubwa wa gololi au zaidi, na hugeuka manjano yakiiva.
about.dg: *Mtungudza koma* ni chitsaka chenye laika za rangi ya ivu, na chenye miya mikali kpwenye makolo na makodza. Maruwage ni ga zambarau, ga rangi ya mandano kahi-kahi, na gana umbo dza ra maruwa ga nyanya na *bungulia*, ambago ni ndugu zakpwe. Matunda ni ga mviringo, makulu dza gololi au zaidi, na ganakala ga rangi ya mandano ganaphoivwa.

where.en: It grows on disturbed ground, fallow land and in bushland, often along paths and around old fields.
where.sw: Hukua kwenye ardhi iliyovurugwa, mashamba yaliyoachwa na katika nyika ya vichaka, mara nyingi kando ya vijia na kuzunguka mashamba ya zamani.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye tsi iriyobanangwa, minda iriyorichwa na weruni, mara nyinji kanda-kanda ya njira na phephi na minda ya kare.

uses.en: The Digo of Diani boil the roots and leaves to treat malaria. The fruits are not eaten.
uses.sw: Wadigo wa Diani huchemsha mizizi na majani kutibu malaria. Matunda yake hayaliwi.
uses.dg: Adigo a Diani nkuchemusha mizi na makodza kuhenda dawa ya homa (malaria). Matunda tagariwa.

culture.en: The name means 'wild *tungudza*': it is seen as the inedible wild form of the cultivated garden egg.
culture.sw: Jina lake lina maana ya '*tungudza* ya porini': huonekana kama aina ya porini isiyolika ya ngogwe inayolimwa.
culture.dg: Dzina rina mana ya '*tungudza* ya weruni': nkuonekana dza aina ya weruni ya *tungudza* inayophandwa, isiyoriwa.

names.en: The Digo name *mtungudza koma* is shared with Duruma and Swahili. In English it is the Sodom apple. The Mgombato dictionary records *koma* as the fruit of the doum palm, a different word, so how *koma* comes to mean 'wild' here is unclear.
names.sw: Jina la Kidigo *mtungudza koma* linatumika pia kwa Kiduruma na Kiswahili. Kwa Kiingereza ni *Sodom apple*. Kamusi ya Mgombato inarekodi *koma* kama tunda la mkoma, neno tofauti, kwa hiyo haijulikani wazi jinsi *koma* inavyokuja kumaanisha 'ya porini' hapa.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo *mtungudza koma* ni ra Chiduruma na Chiswahili piya. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *Sodom apple*. Kamusi ya Mgombato inaandika *koma* dza tunda ra mkoma, neno ranjina, kpwa hivyo taimanyikana vira *koma* rinavyokala na mana ya 'weruni' phapha.

mgombato: koma3 (ma) fruit of the dwarf or doum palm; koma. (See: mkoma)
